title: Every technician who can lead work shows, with "No work orders" if empty
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. At least one eligible technician with no matching work orders.
custom_steps:
1. Switch to Tech View.
  2. Find the technician with no work.
  3. Read the group's empty label.
  4. Look for any control to hide empty technician groups.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every eligible technician has a group even without matching work, except while Assigned to me is enabled (then only groups holding my work show).
  • A technician group with no work orders under the current filters, and an empty Unassigned group, show the text "No work orders".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10045 — Tech View. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S2-R14, S2-R15 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R14: “Show every eligible technician even without matching work, except while Assigned to me is enabled (S2-R9), subject to the filtered-empty state in S1-N1.”
  • S2-R15: “A technician group with no work orders under the current filters, and an empty Unassigned group, show the text “No work orders”.”
